newsitem.title: NORWAY: Esso spuds dry well in North Sea.
newsitem.headline: Esso spuds dry well in North Sea.

text.p: Esso Norge AS has drilled a dry exploration well on North Sea block 16/7 southeast of the Sleipner East gas and condensate field, the Norwegian Petroleum Directorate (NPD) said on Monday.
The well was drilled to a depth of 2,700 metres below sea level and was premanently plugged and abandoned.
The NPD said exploration well 16/7-6 was spudded under exploration licence 072 in cooperation with licence 101 covering block 16/10.
Partners in licence 072 are Esso, as operator, with 40 percent, Norsk Hydro ASA with 10 percent and Den norske stats oljeselskap (Statoil ) with 50 percent.
Partners in licence 101 are Norsk Agip with 45 percent, Veba AG's Deminex with five percent and Statoil with 50 percent.
